title: Millworx
description: High-quality custom millwork solutions for residential and commercial projects.
about: Millworx came to us with a vision, a brand that matched the precision and craftsmanship behind every piece they build. We worked closely with their team to create visuals that speak to the artistry of custom millwork. From the shop floor to finished installations, we built a full library of video and photography that shows the care behind every cut, joint, and finish.
approach: We kept the tone clean and grounded. Every shot was composed to highlight texture, detail, and the human hands behind the craft, letting the work speak for itself. Macro details of joinery, slow deliberate camera moves, and the natural light of the workshop gave the content the same patience the craft demands.

title: LZ World Tour
description: Capturing the adrenaline and excitement of the LZ World Tour.
about: The LZ World Tour is one of the most electric events in the drifting world, and we were brought in to capture every second of the chaos, skill, and culture that surrounds it. We covered the action trackside and in the pits, documenting the drivers, the builds, and the fans that make the tour what it is.
approach: Fast cuts, kinetic camera movement, and an eye for the raw emotion on and off the track. We wanted the viewer to feel the heat and noise of the event, not just watch it. Long lenses put us close to the tire smoke and near misses, while roaming coverage in the paddock caught the personalities behind the wheel.

title: Facility Plus
description: Professional maintenance and facility management solutions for businesses.
about: Facility Plus needed content that reflected their reliability and professionalism. We set out to show not just what they do, but the care and precision behind every job they take on. The result was a brand video and photo library their team now uses across their website, proposals, and social channels.
approach: We followed their team on-site, capturing the real work in real environments. The goal was authenticity over polish, letting the quality of their service do the talking. Minimal staging, practical light, and real crews at work kept every frame honest to how the company actually operates.

title: Custom Glass Railings
description: Innovative solutions and services for modern businesses.
about: Custom Glass Railings creates architectural pieces that blend safety with beauty. Our job was to translate the elegance of their installations into video and photography that matched the product. We documented completed residential installations to build a portfolio that positions them for the high-end projects they want to win.
approach: We focused on light, reflection, and geometry. Clean compositions and careful framing to showcase the craftsmanship in every panel and post. We timed our shoots for when the glass catches light best, and slow, deliberate camera moves trace the lines of each installation the way the eye does in person.

title: Mike & Brittany
description: A beautiful story captured through cinematography.
about: Mike and Brittany trusted us with one of the most important days of their lives. Every frame was treated with the weight and love that their story deserved. From the quiet morning preparations to the last dance, we followed the full arc of the day so nothing was lost.
approach: Unobtrusive and present. We moved quietly through the day, capturing genuine moments as they unfolded, blending documentary instincts with cinematic intention. The final film was cut to the rhythm of the day itself, letting the vows, the speeches, and the small glances carry the story.

title: Janine & Lucas
description: Celebrating love and special moments with stunning visuals.
about: Janine and Lucas brought warmth, laughter, and a deep love to everything around them on their wedding day. We were there to make sure none of it was forgotten. Their celebration mixed tradition with personality, and the film needed to hold both, the formal moments and the ones nobody planned.
approach: We let the day breathe. Candid moments, natural light, and an editorial eye that turned real emotions into timeless frames. Rather than directing the day, we stayed ready for it, anticipating moments before they happened so the couple could simply live them.

title: Luka Dental Care
description: Providing high-quality dental care services with professionalism and care.
about: Luka Dental Care wanted to build trust before a patient even walks through the door. We created content that communicated their warmth, expertise, and modern approach to dentistry. The project included a pair of videos introducing the practice, along with photography for their website and social presence.
approach: Bright, clean visuals paired with genuine moments from the team. The focus was on making patients feel comfortable and confident in the care they would receive. We captured real interactions between staff and patients, because trust is built on faces, not equipment.

title: Power Yoga Canada
description: Empowering individuals through movement, mindfulness, and strength.
about: Power Yoga Canada is more than a studio, it is a community built around intention and growth. We wanted the visuals to capture the energy of the space and the people who fill it. The content needed to speak to both new students walking in for the first time and the longtime members who call the studio home.
approach: Dynamic movement, natural light, and a focus on the human experience. We shot during live classes and quiet moments alike to tell the full story of what PYC is about. Breath, sweat, and stillness all made the cut, because the practice is all of those things at once.

title: Queen Street Dental
description: Premium dental care services in a comfortable environment.
about: Queen Street Dental came to us looking to modernize their brand presence. We helped them communicate their commitment to quality care through a visual identity that felt approachable and professional. The new content gave their website and social channels a consistent look that finally matched the standard of care inside the practice.
approach: Soft tones, patient-centered storytelling, and a focus on the people behind the practice. We highlighted both the team and the space to build familiarity and trust. By the time a new patient arrives, the office already feels like somewhere they have been before.

title: Tommy & Victoria
description: A special wedding story captured beautifully.
about: Tommy and Victoria's wedding was filled with elegance, family, and unforgettable moments. We were honored to be the ones preserving it all. From the ceremony through the reception, we documented the day with the same attention the couple put into planning it.
approach: Cinematic and timeless. We blended wide establishing shots with intimate close-ups, crafting a film that felt as grand and personal as the day itself. Every scene was graded and paced to feel like something the family will still want to watch decades from now.

title: Finkle Street
description: Serving up great food, drinks, and atmosphere in a welcoming space.
about: Finkle Street Tap and Grill is a local staple with serious heart. We were brought in to capture the character of the space and the experience of being there. The content covers everything that makes the spot work, the kitchen, the bar, the regulars, and the nights that fill the room.
approach: Warm tones, close detail shots of food and drinks, and a focus on the energy of the room. We wanted people to feel hungry and welcome just from watching. We shot during real service so the atmosphere in every frame is the genuine article, not a staged version of it.

title: Roberto & Lorena
description: Celebrating love and joy with a beautiful engagement party story.
about: Roberto and Lorena's engagement celebration was vibrant, joyful, and full of the people they love most. We were there to capture the start of their next chapter. Nights like this move fast, and our job was to hold onto the moments the couple was too busy living to notice.
approach: Lively and warm. We leaned into the energy of the room, the dancing, the laughter, and the quiet in-between moments that make celebrations worth remembering. We kept the coverage candid and close, so the final film feels like being back in the room rather than watching it from outside.

title: Ship & Zach
description: A lakeside wedding filled with quiet mornings, golden light, and lasting love.
about: Ship and Zach said 'I do' on the shores of Calabogie Peaks, surrounded by family, friends, and the kind of view most couples only dream of for their wedding day. We followed the day from the first quiet moments of getting ready through the ceremony by the water and into a night of celebration, making sure every detail and every emotion was preserved.
approach: Soft, natural light and unscripted moments guided our coverage. We stayed close during the quiet preparation, then pulled back to let the lake and the golden hour do the heavy lifting during the ceremony and portraits. The result is a film and photo set that feels as calm and genuine as the day itself.

title: North York Dental
description: North York Dental - Excellence in Dental Care.
about: North York Dental wanted content that reflected their reputation for excellence and patient care. We worked to show the human side of their practice alongside their clinical expertise. The finished content gives prospective patients an honest look at the team and the space before they ever book an appointment.
approach: Clean, professional, and warm. We focused on the team's interactions with patients and the welcoming environment they have built to put people at ease. Bright, natural framing kept the clinical spaces feeling open rather than sterile.

title: Stairs 4u
description: Crafting high-quality, custom stair solutions that blend design, durability, and functionality.
about: Stairs 4U builds staircases that become centerpieces of a home. We partnered with them to create content that honored the artistry and precision behind every installation. Across a series of videos and photography, we documented the range of their work, from modern floating designs to classic craftsmanship.
approach: We shot across multiple completed projects, emphasizing the interplay of material, light, and space. The work speaks best in context, so we let the homes tell the story. Camera movement followed the natural lines of each staircase, giving the viewer the feeling of walking the space themselves.

title: The Doors Ltd
description: Providing premium custom door solutions with expert craftsmanship.
about: The Doors Ltd brings exceptional detail and craftsmanship to every project they take on. We created photography that matched the quality and character of their custom work. The image library covers their range of styles and finishes, giving their clients a true sense of what is possible.
approach: Architectural framing with an eye for texture and material. Every image was composed to let the doors command the space the way they do in person. We paid close attention to grain, hardware, and finish, the details that separate custom work from everything else.

title: Chamber of Commerce
description: Connecting businesses and professionals to strengthen economic ties.
about: The Chamber of Commerce event brought together local leaders and entrepreneurs for an evening of connection and conversation. We were on the ground to document every moment. The photo set gives the organization a record of the evening and content to promote the events that follow.
approach: Event photography with an editorial edge. We moved through the room capturing genuine interactions, key speakers, and the atmosphere that makes these gatherings matter. We stayed light on our feet and out of the way, so every handshake and conversation in the set is a real one.

title: JDRF Walk to Cure Diabetes
description: Bringing communities together to raise awareness and funds for type 1 diabetes research, driving progress toward a cure.
about: The JDRF Walk to Cure Diabetes is a powerful gathering of families, supporters, and advocates united by a common purpose. We were there to document the heart behind the movement. The video and photography help the organization share the story of the walk and bring even more people out the next year.
approach: Human-first storytelling. We focused on the faces, the signs, the small moments of solidarity that show why this cause matters and why people keep showing up. We covered the day from the first arrivals to the finish, letting the community itself be the subject.

title: Copernicus Lodge Galaxy Ball
description: An elegant evening of celebration and philanthropy, supporting Copernicus Lodge's mission.
about: The Copernicus Lodge Galaxy Ball is an annual celebration of community, culture, and generosity. We were brought in to capture the grandeur and the warmth of an evening that truly meant something. Our coverage followed the whole event, from the arrivals and speeches to the moments between them.
approach: Elegant and attentive. We worked to honor the occasion through rich photography that captured the decor, the people, and the shared purpose that brought everyone into the room. We treated the evening with the same formality the guests did, polished coverage that never interrupted the celebration.

title: Waterloo Family Dental
description: Providing compassionate, high-quality dental care for the whole family in a welcoming and professional environment.
about: Waterloo Family Dental is built around its community. We helped them bring that family-first philosophy to life through content that felt genuine, warm, and inviting. The video and photography give families a real sense of the practice before their first visit.
approach: Bright, natural visuals focused on the team and patient experience. We kept the energy light and approachable to reflect the kind of practice they have built. Real smiles over stock-photo polish, because that is exactly what walking into their office feels like.

title: Brilliant Minded Women
description: Celebrating and empowering exceptional women in business, leadership, and philanthropy.
about: Brilliant Minded Women is a platform that elevates and celebrates women who are shaping their communities and industries. We were privileged to document their gathering and amplify their story. The photography captures the honorees, the speakers, and the energy of a room full of people who are building things that matter.
approach: Bold and empowering. We shot with intention, ensuring every image reflected the confidence and brilliance of the women in the room. Strong portraiture, decisive framing, and coverage that treated every honoree like the headline of the evening.

title: Dentistry On Lawrence
description: Delivering personalized and professional dental care with a focus on comfort, innovation, and lasting smiles.
about: Dentistry on Lawrence is a practice defined by its attention to detail and its commitment to patient experience. We created content that put their values front and center. The video and photo set now anchor their online presence, giving new patients a clear picture of who they are.
approach: Polished and personal. We focused on the balance between clinical excellence and the warmth of the team, making sure both came through in every frame. We built the shoot around real appointments and genuine conversations, keeping the polish without losing the person.

title: Lululemon Madness
description: A high-energy community event hosted by Lululemon, bringing people together through movement, mindfulness, and fun.
about: Lululemon Madness brought their community together for a day of movement, connection, and good energy. We were there to document every sweaty, joyful moment of it. The photo set captures the scale of the event and the individual moments that made it feel personal.
approach: High energy and high pace. We matched the vibe of the event with dynamic photography that captured the movement, the community, and the unmistakable spirit of the brand. We moved with the crowd instead of around it, shooting from inside the workouts to keep every frame alive.

title: National Bank Open
description: Capturing the energy and excitement of the National Bank Open tennis tournament.
about: The National Bank Open is one of Canada's premier sporting events, drawing world-class athletes and passionate fans. We were on the ground to capture the spectacle from every angle. Our coverage moved between the court, the crowd, and the grounds to tell the full story of the tournament experience.
approach: Fast, precise, and immersive. We worked to put the viewer courtside, capturing the speed of the game and the atmosphere of a world-class sporting event. Tight action coverage paired with the roar of the stands, so the energy of the venue comes through in every cut.

title: RWB Kansha
description: Capturing the raw beauty and craftsmanship of Rauh-Welt Begriff's iconic Porsche builds.
about: RWB is a cult in the automotive world, and Kansha is one of their most celebrated Canadian builds. We were given rare access to document the car and the culture surrounding it. The film honors what a Rauh-Welt build represents, hours of handwork and a philosophy you can see in every bolt-on fender.
approach: Low angles, golden hour light, and a reverence for the machine. We treated the car like a subject worthy of the same care and attention Akira puts into every build. Slow, deliberate coverage let the lines and stance of the car do the talking, no gimmicks needed.

title: Slammedenuff Sevierville 2024
description: An unforgettable showcase of custom cars and automotive culture, Slammedenuff Sevierville 2024 brought enthusiasts together for a weekend of style, creativity, and community.
about: Slammedenuff Sevierville 2024 was a convergence of the best in stance and custom car culture. We traveled to document the builds, the people, and the passion behind one of the scene's most anticipated events. Between the show floor and the conversations around it, the weekend gave us more stories than we could fit in one edit.
approach: Wide and detailed. We captured the scale of the show through sweeping wide shots and then got in close on the details that make each build unique, letting the culture speak for itself. Every build at a show like this is someone's years of work, and we shot each one like it.
